title: WPA Protocolometry / Institute Index v1.0 Readiness Gates
principle: A calculable score is not by itself permission to publish a ranking.

gates.name: Universe control
gates.pass_rule: REV7 canonical baseline frozen; current entity-resolution and successor/branch rules documented; no unresolved duplicate materially affects the controlled scoring universe.
blockers: four completed first-pass dossiers still lack a direct REV7 canonical crosswalk
seven resolution-before-dossier cases remain unresolved
Protocolometry scoring Pilot 20 IDs are not yet frozen

gates.name: Evidence corpus
gates.pass_rule: Target dossier corpus completed or formally withheld with documented reasons; all scored pilot cases satisfy dossier schema and provenance rules.
blockers: target dossier corpus is incomplete
four of six completed dossiers still lack direct REV7 identity crosswalks
only one of six completed dossiers meets evidence-coverage thresholds
no completed dossier has authorised human review approval for method testing

gates.name: Scoring reproducibility
gates.pass_rule: Two independent scoring passes completed on Pilot 20 with disagreement log and human reconciliation.
blockers: G01 scoring Pilot 20 universe is not frozen
G02 has zero authorised method-test-ready dossiers
two independent real Pilot 20 scoring passes do not exist
human reconciliation has not been performed

gates.name: Inter-rater reliability
gates.pass_rule: Agreement diagnostics calculated at indicator and dimension level; material low-agreement indicators are revised or explicitly justified.
blockers: G03 real independent double-scoring has not started
no frozen Pilot 20 score-pair corpus exists
no real indicator/dimension agreement report exists
no human review of material low-agreement indicators has occurred

gates.name: Evidence coverage behavior
gates.pass_rule: 80% overall and 60% per-dimension thresholds tested against high- and low-transparency institutions; no systematic missing-data penalty is introduced indirectly.
blockers: frozen Pilot 20 does not exist
G02 has zero authorised method-test-ready dossiers
no approved real high-/low-transparency edge-case set exists
no real missingness analysis by region and peer type exists

gates.name: Weight robustness
gates.pass_rule: 30/25/25/20 compared against approved diagnostic alternatives; large unstable result changes trigger review before freeze.
blockers: no frozen Pilot 20 reconciled score corpus exists
G03/G04 real scoring and reconciliation have not occurred
no real score-drift or pairwise-stability report exists
no human-approved instability interpretation rule exists

gates.name: Indicator redundancy
gates.pass_rule: Correlation/overlap diagnostics performed; double-counting or near-duplicate signals are documented and addressed.
blockers: no frozen real Pilot 20 reconciled indicator matrix exists
G03/G04 real scoring and reconciliation have not occurred
no real shared-evidence overlap report exists
no human conceptual review of flagged indicator pairs has occurred

gates.name: Peer-type fairness
gates.pass_rule: State academies, university-linked, independent protocol and international training bodies tested for structural advantage/disadvantage unrelated to intended quality constructs.
blockers: no frozen Pilot 20 with all four peer types exists
no real small-specialist versus large-institution edge-case review exists
no real peer-type missingness/applicability analysis exists
no authorised human fairness review has occurred

gates.name: Language and regional fairness
gates.pass_rule: Non-English primary evidence workflow tested; no score advantage is created merely by English-language or web-marketing intensity.
blockers: no frozen Pilot 20 with meaningful regional/language diversity exists
no real non-English primary-evidence workflow has been exercised
no real English-rich versus non-English discoverability comparison exists
no human review of regional/language missingness patterns has occurred

gates.name: Anti-gaming review
gates.pass_rule: Common gaming routes tested: partnership inflation, publication quantity without relevance, duplicated evidence, marketing-only claims and superficial digital presence.
blockers: no frozen Pilot 20 scoring workflow exists for adversarial testing
no real red-team exercise has tested source/dossier manipulation routes
no human review has assessed anti-gaming false-positive risk
no operational escalation procedure has been exercised on a controlled real dossier

gates.name: Correction test
gates.pass_rule: At least one controlled factual correction cycle tested end-to-end with source submission, reviewer decision, version history and score impact where applicable.

gates.name: Conflict-of-interest control
gates.pass_rule: Reviewer COI rules operational and tested; institutional relationships cannot affect inclusion, scoring or correction outcomes.

gates.name: Shadow Index stability
gates.pass_rule: Non-public comparative output generated and stress-tested; material ordinal instability or unexplained outliers are resolved or disclosed.

gates.name: Methodology freeze
gates.pass_rule: Exact indicator definitions, anchors, weights, formulas, evidence rules, snapshot date, peer logic, correction procedure and changelog frozen as v1.0.

gates.name: Independent methodological review
gates.pass_rule: AAB or equivalent authorised independent methodological review completed after formal constitution and COI declaration.

gates.name: Publication decision
gates.pass_rule: Authorised human governance selects scorecards only, score bands, or ordinal ranking; no release mode activates automatically.

release_modes.R1: Reviewed institutional scorecards and evidence coverage without ordinal ordering.
release_modes.R2: Score bands or peer-group comparative profiles without a strict 1..N ranking.
release_modes.R3: Ordinal ranking, only after all gates pass and separate explicit governance approval.
